Description: Infection/transmission from susceptible to infectious individuals.

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number explored for pandemic influenza; moderate scenario 1.7 and high scenario 2.0.

Name: Generation time
Description: Assumed generation time for the pandemic influenza simulations.

Name: Clinical fraction
Description: Assumed proportion of infected individuals ill enough to be classified as clinical cases.

Name: Household transmission proportion
Description: Estimated proportion of transmission occurring within households in the United States model.

Name: Non-household transmission proportion
Description: Estimated proportion of transmission occurring outside the household in the United States model.

Name: Community transmission proportion
Description: Assumed share of non-household transmission occurring in the general community.

Name: School/workplace transmission proportion
Description: Assumed share of non-household transmission occurring in schools and workplaces.
